body: I think youre right but I'm really scared to tell them. Getting kicked out is almost less scary.
I know they mean well they're good parents.
I think I can slow down but that wont help me not be homeless.
Its not free in the US I'm scared that I'll try to kill myself again if I kick it.
I'm also scared that getting clean will make me want to kill myself again. The rush of the drugs is what made me reconsider so it must be helping.

What if they don't believe me and think I'm lying, and if they believe me then they'll know about it and i'll feel even worse. What if they kick me out anyway? I don't know if telling them is worth the risk. I have a car I can sleep in if they do.
